top_signals.title: Surprising Netflix Is Not Looking at Other Opportunities: Fmr. Content Director
top_signals.summary: Simon Gallagher, Hanaging Director of SPG Global and a Former Netflix Content-Acquisition Director, says hiring Peter Rice signals a more commercial programming strategy. While niche titles can succeed, Gallagher argues Netflix should lean more toward broadly appealing films and shows to support growth. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
